translations.web: The multitude answered, “You have a demon! Who seeks to kill you?”
translations.bsb: “You have a demon,” the crowd replied. “Who is trying to kill You?”
translations.kjv: The people answered and said, Thou hast a devil: who goeth about to kill thee?
translations.asv: The multitude answered, Thou hast a demon: who seeketh to kill thee?
